ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels (~5-10%) concentrated at the distal tips and specific mid-lobe mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-grey/black region across both lobes; localized high-contrast white geometric clusters at the extreme distal tips; sparse white punctate marks visible on the central-left lobe and adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; estimated angle of 40 degrees between the inner lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; the left lobe displays more jagged, high-amplitude peaks compared to the slightly smoother, more rounded peaks on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the posterior boundary, sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups at both distal tips, consistent with barnacle colonization or attachment scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple short, unaligned white linear streaks on the left lobe surface, approximately 15-20 pixels in length at current resolution.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy white scarring and irregular tissue texture at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged protrusion on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the tip.
